ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central field versus 15% low-intensity black pixels localized at margins and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white central region; black pigmentation map follows the trailing edge border with irregular inward encroachment; high-contrast black pixel clusters present at the fluke-peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 120 degrees; depth is minimal relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous moderate-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley amplitude is higher on the distal thirds of both lobes; visible irregular notches on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along trailing edges; sharp tapering at distal tips with an upward sweep; leading edge exhibits a smooth concave trajectory towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity white circular nodes (barnacles) on the far left tip; group of 4-6 light-colored circular ring scars visible on the right lobe medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear mark at the central base; several faint, unaligned grey-tone linear markings on the lower quadrants of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the left distal tip; multiple circular focal scars on the right lobe; significant dark vertical scarification at the fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark, vertical 'columnar' pigment streak originating from the median notch extending toward the peduncle.
